differentials: Compartment syndrome without free flap indication
Closed fracture with intact soft tissue envelope
Osteomyelitis without acute soft tissue defect
Vascular injury requiring primary repair only
red_flags: A cold, pale, pulseless foot; new sensory or motor deficit; or pain out of proportion
Fever, escalating drainage, spreading redness, or systemic illness suggesting wound infection

must_ask.say: How did the crash happen, and how long ago was the injury?
Was the wound cleaned or treated at another hospital before you got here?

must_ask.objective: Sensation and circulation in the limb
must_ask.say: Can you feel and move your toes, and is the foot warm?

must_ask.objective: Pain out of proportion or swelling
must_ask.say: Is the pain much worse than expected, or does the leg feel very tight and swollen?

must_ask.objective: Smoking status and comorbidities affecting flap healing
must_ask.say: Do you smoke, and do you have diabetes or any circulation problems?
